units.rawText: That was a textbook infiltration, but then you reused the same location for multiple observations... Even a battle-type without counter-surveillance modules installed would have noticed you.

units.rawText: Wait, you again?

units.rawText: Did the administrator order you to keep an eye on us? Nameless is a pretty big guy, so I suppose you'd be better at hiding.

units.rawText: So you're saying... You were the one who came to see us on the day of the concert?
units.displayText: So you're saying... You were the one who came to see us on the day of the concert?

spans.text: So you're saying... You were the one who came to see us on the day of the concert?

units.rawText: ...You noticed me?
units.displayText: ...You noticed me?

units.rawText: Yes. You seemed to be trying to approach the stage. Given the circumstances, continuing the concert would only have added to the chaos of the situation, so I canceled it.

spans.text: Yes. You seemed to be trying to approach the stage. Given the circumstances, continuing the concert would only have added to the chaos of the situation, so I canceled it.

units.rawText: Monitor104 could not ignore you. Monitor104 wanted to see your show... It seems Monitor104 has developed irregular ideation.

spans.text: Monitor104 could not ignore you. Monitor104 wanted to see your show... It seems Monitor104 has developed irregular ideation.

units.displayText: Irregular? I remember the Professor mentioned something about strange phenomena in Cyclopes recently.

units.rawText: There have been more and more Irregular Agents in this sector. Monitor104 might be turning into one of them.

units.rawText: The source of the irregularity is unknown. The first irregular individual Monitor104 encountered was the battle-type agent in my charge, Sortie104...

units.displayText: Sortie104, you are among the elite of the battle-type agents, but you have been making errors frequently during your recent training sessions.

spans.text: Sortie104, you are among the elite of the battle-type agents, but you have been making errors frequently during your recent training sessions.

units.displayText: The first time I encountered you, Monitor104 was carrying out Sortie104's patrol mission in her place, and you faced me alone to protect your teammates.

units.displayText: Monitor104 realized that you were different from the agents of Cyclopes.

units.rawText: Then, when Monitor104 saw 4You's concert, Monitor104 felt that 4You was shining very brightly...
units.displayText: Then, when Monitor104 saw 4You's concert, Monitor104 felt that 4You was shining very brightly...

spans.text: Then, when Monitor104 saw 4You's concert, Monitor104 felt that 4You was shining very brightly...

units.displayText: You thought 4You was shining brightly?

spans.text: You thought 4You was shining brightly?

units.rawText: Yeah. It was a brilliance that Monitor104 had never seen in Cyclopes before.
units.displayText: Yeah. It was a brilliance that Monitor104 had never seen in Cyclopes before.

units.rawText: No, it's not just Monitor104... There have been an increasing number of irregular occurrences throughout Cyclopes Sector these few days.
units.displayText: No, it's not just Monitor104... There have been an increasing number of irregular occurrences throughout Cyclopes Sector these few days.

spans.text: No, it's not just Monitor104... There have been an increasing number of irregular occurrences throughout Cyclopes Sector these few days.

spans.text: The most recent trending keywords on Cyclopes' intranet have been things like stage, music, and idols...

units.displayText: Monitor104 doesn't quite understand this feeling yet... but perhaps this is what Sortie104 meant by "something that was meaningful"...

spans.text: Monitor104 doesn't quite understand this feeling yet... but perhaps this is what Sortie104 meant by "something that was meaningful"...

units.rawText: And that's why I hope you'll keep singing.
units.displayText: And that's why I hope you'll keep singing.

units.rawText: Um...
units.displayText: Um...

spans.text: Even if you're the only one watching, 4You will still do their best on stage.

units.rawText: After all, it's in our name; we exist for everyone in Magrasea, for you...
units.displayText: After all, it's in our name; we exist for everyone in Magrasea, for you...

spans.text: After all, it's in our name; we exist for everyone in Magrasea, for you...

units.rawText: Oho... Now that was a fine speech Clukay just made, completely unlike how she's Miss-Can't-Spit-It-Out in her daily life.

units.rawText: Ah choo! Why are we even hiding here? We're all members of 4You, right?

spans.text: Ah choo! Why are we even hiding here? We're all members of 4You, right?

units.displayText: Just then, the cool night wind blows and makes the other members of the group shiver from where they're hiding behind the stage backdrop.

spans.text: Just then, the cool night wind blows and makes the other members of the group shiver from where they're hiding behind the stage backdrop.

units.rawText: Ugh... I can't quite hear them. If only I could get a little closer...
units.displayText: Ugh... I can't quite hear them. If only I could get a little closer...

spans.text: Ugh... I can't quite hear them. If only I could get a little closer...

units.displayText: Shhh—Clukay's having an intimate interaction with a fan. If we disturbed them now, we'd scare off our first fan from Cyclopes.

units.rawText: But that's just because someone leaves their room every night as if they're sleepwalking. We were worried they might be possessed by a demon or something, so we were just curious...
